about_the_game:
There is chaos in Seabreak. After many investigations in this area, a large source of Aurorium has been found (a rare useful material). As a result, part of the land has now been cordoned off to allow everything to be excavated. After many intense runs, almost the entire population of the city and surrounding area was evacuated. Three groups remain: Bandits; workers at SEABREAK INC. (the largest Aurorium company in the world) and a group that fights against SEABREAK INC. and anyone who stands in their way.

SCAVENGE

Explore, collect, and create an array of diverse items and progress through tiers of loot. Uncover weaponry, tools, consumables, medical supplies, equipment, electronics. This and an extensive array of other essentials for survival or upgrading your hideout.

MAP

Discover the colorful world of Seabreak, explore abandoned POI's and dangerous area's

SURVIVE

Try to survive in this danger zone. Fight away the danger. Be careful! dont stay here too long. Any injury disrupts your senses and abilities. If you die all your loot in your inventory will be lost.

TRADE

Fear not, there is a safe zone in this place of chaos. At the park-center, you can make new allies, trade with NPCs and accept missions.

UPGRADE

Upgrade your vehicle storage with new vehicles trough gathering loot and supplies by completing missions, chasing away enemies and extracting.

EXTRACT

Seabreak valley is almost completely surrounded by a barrier called The border area. Will you flee the area? Or fight off all the enemies. Be careful, there are a lot of NPC's securing the place even in the sky.

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes features violent content and other mature themes.
